title: explicit id for label helper
rule: Explicit `id` for label + helper association — input linked to label and helper (`for` / `aria-describedby`). Until hydration, a TextField without an explicit `id` will not have associated labels.
pass_when: TextField has an explicit `id`; label uses `for`; helper is `aria-describedby`.
fail_when: No explicit `id`, so label/helper are not associated (including pre-hydration).
waive_reason: agent_fields pending — do not invent from harvest stencil
do_not_claim: Visible-label existence (`forms.field_labels.visible_label`) as this association row.
